name: plannotator
description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

issues.title: [Feature Request] Continuous review sessions with live updates and agent replies
Inbox: the browser tab uses 1.6 GB, even right after a reload, with a large store
PR review mode: pluggable platforms and two-way review threads
[BUG] Share link export only includes active file instead of full folder context
Review: Server error: RangeError: Out of memory
Plan HTML page takes around 5 seconds to load and shows a long loading state on macOS
[Feature Request] Allow direct edits in addition to suggestions.

discussions.title: Plannotator process are being left in the background
Why does plannotator-tui re-implement Plannotator's logic instead of sharing one engine?
Any plans for integration with the new official Herdr native app?
Planotator as productivity and weekly tasks review

latest_release.name: v0.28.64
latest_release.body:
Follow [@plannotator](https://x.com/plannotator) on X for updates
Missed recent releases? | Release | Highlights | |---|---| | [v0.28.63](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.63) | Pair Grok Bot and other cloud agents from Settings, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw and Muse Code can use the Inbox, add a thread to Priority to keep it on top, tag threads, and find each tag in the sidebar, Pull requests board as a table, with bulk Merge | | [v0.28.62](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.62) | Agents started from the Inbox now work on Windows, pick a model and effort when you start an agent, rules for your agents, written in your own words, post a thread's decisions on its pull request, the Inbox loads faster on a slow connection | | [v0.28.61](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.61) | Updates now update the Claude Code plugin too, an agent's chosen face shows on every icon of it, filter the Inbox list by pull request state, Modern dark shows section bands and the Reply button, one conversation no longer shows as two agents | | [v0.28.60](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.60) | Click a word to highlight it, a one-time Themes dialog, Settings → Rows rebuilt, tell your agent how you want your rows, starred threads as pills above the list, a pill for new messages out of view, a half-circle face picker with ten Glass colours, a new phone sidebar and reply box | | [v0.28.59](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.59) | A quieter Agents section in the sidebar, machine names only when agents run on more than one machine, agent icons that are always gently alive and lean toward your pointer | | [v0.28.58](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.58) | Start Codex from New message, an Agents section in the sidebar, start an agent in a folder on any drive, play audio attachments and comment at a moment, Claude Code's Plannotator tools work on Windows | | [v0.28.57](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.57) | Pin artifacts, and see every artifact on one page, filter the list by project, date or agent, a thread shows its pull requests and their state, choose what the sidebar shows, and in what order, Ask AI starts from Side in the selection bar | | [v0.28.56](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.56) | Questions can show trade-offs and a prototype to try, a thread with many big pictures no longer crashes the tab, Escape closes New message and keeps your draft, read threads stop being bold and keep their place, agent messages that name no thread start a new one | | [v0.28.55](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.55) | Floating reply drafts, now a setting under Experimental, open questions sit next to Reply again, a comment box that keeps unsent comments as Drafts, choose how your list looks: Minimal, Balanced or Detailed, update an older linked machine from this Inbox | | [v0.28.53](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.53) | Start an agent in a new folder, or from a git URL, "+" on each project row starts a session there, a reaction tray, a thread's Links, Settings → Activity, New message offers the open thread's files, Bro mode: agents write to you in plain words | | [v0.28.52](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.52) | Start agents from the Inbox, on by default, a new reply box, Ask AI for everyone, Insights in Settings → Decision data, Plannotator reloads itself after an update | | [v0.28.51](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/releases/tag/v0.28.51) | Starred threads, a note when an agent's session has ended, "Back from snooze", Ask about a past decision, expand arrows in guided reviews |
## What's New in v0.28.64 ### TL;DR - **Changed:** Installs and updates download a smaller, compressed copy - **New:** A Videos
